INSERT INTO tournament_device_assessment (device_id, assessment_date, device_type, cgpi_score, latency_ms, polling_rate_hz, wireless_latency, qualifies_for_tournament, standard_version)
SELECT DISTINCT
    di.devregistry AS device_id,
    CURRENT_DATE AS assessment_date,
    ts.devscope AS device_type,
    ROUND(CAST(
        ((ts.pollratehz / 100.0 * (1.0 - (ts.inplagms + ts.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10.0) * 0.4
        + (di.dpires / 1000.0 * (1.0 - di.mcresptime / 10.0) * 10.0) * 0.3
        + CASE WHEN m.mechdevref IS NOT NULL THEN (LOG(m.keychatter / 2.0) * m.swtchcons / 7.0) * 0.2 ELSE 0 END
        + ((COALESCE(i.joyprec, 0) + COALESCE(i.dpadacc, 0)) / 20.0 * (1.0 - ts.inplagms / 10.0) * 10.0 * 0.1
    ), 4) AS cgpi_score,
    ts.latms AS latency_ms,
    ts.pollratehz AS polling_rate_hz,
    di.wllatvar AS wireless_latency,
    CASE WHEN 
        -- Tournament criteria: CGPI > 8.0, LatMs < 2.0, PollRateHz >= 1000, WlLatVar < 1.0 if wireless
        CASE WHEN ts.devscope IN ('Mouse', 'Keyboard', 'Controller', 'Gamepad')
            AND (
                ((ts.pollratehz / 100.0 * (1.0 - (ts.inplagms + ts.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10.0) * 0.4
                + (di.dpires / 1000.0 * (1.0 - di.mcresptime / 10.0) * 10.0) * 0.3
                + CASE WHEN m.mechdevref IS NOT NULL THEN (LOG(m.keychatter / 2.0) * m.swtchcons / 7.0) * 0.2 ELSE 0 END
                + ((COALESCE(i.joyprec, 0) + COALESCE(i.dpadacc, 0)) / 20.0 * (1.0 - ts.inplagms / 10.0) * 10.0 * 0.1

            AND ts.latms < 2.0
            AND ts.pollratehz >= 1000
            AND (di.conntype = 'Wired' OR (di.conntype IN ('Wireless 2.4GHz', 'Bluetooth', 'Hybrid') AND di.wllatvar < 1.0))
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
    END AS qualifies_for_tournament,
    'v1.0' AS standard_version

LEFT JOIN mechanical m ON di.devregistry = m.mechdevref
